report_profiles._ai_53_notes: AI-53 VERIFIE le 2026-07-19 : endpoint POST /api/campaign-values-reports/ (Reporting API). Granularite daily via interval='daily'. Statistiques disponibles : sends, opens, clicks, conversions, revenue. Profondeur d'historique : non documentee explicitement -- a confirmer en passe live (Phase B) via test de fenetre historique. Source : https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/reporting_api_overview

AI-53 VERIFIE le 2026-07-19 : endpoint POST /api/flow-series-reports/ (Reporting API, serie temporelle daily). Statistiques identiques. Source : https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/reporting_api_overview

_account_topology_note: Klaviyo is scoped to a single account per Private API Key — there is no account hierarchy to discover. The key grants access to exactly one Klaviyo account. No account_topology block is required: discovery is implicit (the key IS the account selector). No *_ACCOUNT_ID env var is used.

quota._ai_53_notes: AI-53 VERIFIE le 2026-07-19 : le endpoint /api/metric-aggregates (et par extension les Reporting API endpoints) a un rate limit de Tier S : burst 3 req/s, steady 60 req/min. Source : https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/query_metric_aggregates. Le profil retenu (window 60s / 60pts / read_cost=1) modelise la limite steady de 60 req/min de facon conservative. Le backstop reste le handler 429 -> RateLimitError. A recalibrer avec les headers RateLimit-Remaining / RateLimit-Reset en passe live (Phase B).

attribution_window._rule_non_aggregation: REGLE CRITIQUE (AD-4, Epic 15 Story 15.8) : les metriques attributed_conversions et attributed_revenue sont des CONVERSIONS ET REVENUS REVENDIQUES par le canal Klaviyo (fenetre d'attribution last-touch 5j clic/ouverture email par defaut). ILS NE DOIVENT JAMAIS ETRE SOMMES avec les conversions des regies (Meta, TikTok, Google) ni avec le revenue reel Shopify/Stripe dans un total croise. Ce sont des vues d'attribution canal independantes, utilisees pour la deduplication (Epic 17) et non pour calculer un total marketing absolu. Toute agregation croisee requiert la regle AD-4 / cross_source_conversions.
attribution_window._ai_53_notes: AI-53 VERIFIE le 2026-07-19 : fenetres d'attribution par defaut pour les nouveaux comptes (post-10/09/2024) : email click 5j, email open 5j, SMS click 5j, SMS delivered 1j, push 24h. Modele last-touch. Configurable par le compte. Sources : https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260804504250 et https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/introducing-attribution-model-updates-to-reporting

_ai_53_auth: AI-53 VERIFIE le 2026-07-19 : Klaviyo utilise une cle API privee (Private API Key) pour l'authentification. La cle est transmise dans le header Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key <key>. Les secrets transitent UNIQUEMENT via Nango (AD-3) -- jamais hardcodes dans notre code. Source : https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/api_overview
_error_map_note: Reference: Klaviyo 'Error handling' and 'Review API error alerts' (developers.klaviyo.com). Klaviyo answers JSON:API: {"errors": [{"id", "status", "code", "title", "detail", "source"}]} and its 'code' is a STABLE ENUMERATED STRING, not free text -- the earlier reading of it as free text is what left this map empty. The published values keyed here are the ones a read-only reporting pull can meet: 'not_authenticated' (401, credentials not provided / wrong scheme), 'authentication_failed' (401, incorrect credentials), 'permission_denied' (403, key missing the required scope), 'invalid' (400, missing or invalid parameter), 'not_found' (404) and 'server_error' (500). PAYLOAD SHAPE: core.pull_errors._extract_provider_codes does not reach inside an errors[] ARRAY, so connector._klaviyo_error_payload() lifts the FIRST error's 'code' to the top level while preserving the whole errors array as evidence -- exactly the normalisation square performs for its own list shape; core stays free of provider vocabulary (AD-2). WHAT THE KEYS BUY: '401:authentication_failed' becomes auth_revoked rather than auth_expired -- a Klaviyo private key never expires, so a rejected key is one the account rotated or deleted, and the repair is a new key, not a wait; '404:not_found' becomes invalid_request instead of core's retryable 'unclassified', so a metric id that no longer exists stops being requeued to the dead letter. 422 is NOT keyed here: it is generic HTTP semantics that core.pull_errors._base_class_for_status has owned since 2026-08-01. 429 keeps the core.quota.RateLimitError breaker path and is never keyed here.
_max_provider_backfill_days_note: No max_provider_backfill_days is declared because Klaviyo caps a single Reporting API request at a 1-year timeframe but publishes no retention or earliest-date limit; the cap is a page size, not a window (https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/reporting_api_overview). Declaring a guessed window would promise a history the provider never committed to, so this module answers 'unknown' rather than a number (test_backfill_bound_is_declared_or_its_absence_is).
